snippet.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion | Weapons & Gear Trailer - Pre-Order Now
snippet.description:
💥 Ready your nerves and your gear - combat is inevitable, but so is your will to survive.

Alien: Rogue Incursion is coming to PS VR2, Meta Quest 3, and PCVR on December 19th, 2024! Pre-order now and get an Alien: Romulus inspired weapon and armor skin. 🔗 https://bit.ly/AlienRI_Pre-order
